resources.string: Use Shizuku for non-root access to logcat
Direct root access for logcat monitoring

This app captures wish/gacha history URLs from Genshin Impact, Honkai Star Rail, and Zenless Zone Zero by monitoring logcat.

To use:
1. Select your access mode (Shizuku or Root)
2. Open the game and navigate to wish/warp/signal history
3. Tap the capture button
4. The URL will be automatically detected and displayed
5. Copy the URL to import your history
